displayTreatment: Browser-native SVG: original dark ink is separated from local paper illumination (Gaussian blur 18 source pixels minus source, luminance contrast to cyan opacity); subtle blurred duplicate behind the original linework. No pixel edits, no glyph redrawing, no filled lacunae. The SVG presentation filter affects visibility; the unchanged original remains available for comparison.

iconMeaning: Original schematic stone-fragment icon. The strokes are abstract incisions, not hieroglyphic writing or a translated passage.
